A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''individual''' [[Alderaanian/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] served as a military [[Officer/Legends|officer]] on the planet during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of Alderaan's [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the individual joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. After the Alliance destroyed the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the individual served as one of the [[Rebel Honor Guard/Legends|Rebel Honor Guard]] for a post-battle [[Royal Award Ceremony/Legends|ceremony]] held at the Alliance's [[Great Temple/Legends|headquarters]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. The ceremony honored the victorious [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] for their roles in the battle.

==Biography==
[[File:Honor_Guard_ANH.png|thumb|left|180px|The Honor Guard's service at the ceremony honoring the Heroes of Yavin]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="ANH" /> served as a military [[Officer/Legends|officer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Honor Guard" /> During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] Alderaan.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The individual was a survivor of Alderaan's destruction, and by that [[Time/Legends|time]] had joined the Alliance. The individual was among the Alderaanian survivors who retained their ceremonial dress [[uniform]]s following their planet's annihilation.<ref name="Honor Guard" />

In 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the Alliance destroyed the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="NEC" /> A [[Royal Award Ceremony/Legends|ceremony]] was subsequently held in the [[Grand Audience Chamber]] of the Alliance's [[Great Temple/Legends|headquarters]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="ANH" /> Along with a few other survivors of Alderaan,<ref name="Honor Guard" /> the individual was among the [[Rebel Honor Guard/Legends|Rebel Honor Guard]] sentries for that occasion, standing in front of the Chamber's entrance.<ref name="ANH" /> The sentries' Honor Guard duties were in thanks for the efforts of [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] in the battle.<ref name="Honor Guard" />

==Personality and traits==
The Honor Guard was dedicated to ending the Empire's tyranny and possessed [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]],<ref name="Honor Guard" /> and fair skin.<ref name="ANH" />

==Equipment==
The Honor Guard was armed with an [[Electropole/Legends|electropole]]<ref name="ANH" /> as well as a [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]] on Yavin 4 and also preferred a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. As being one of the individuals who maintained dress uniforms from Alderaan, a planet rich in ceremonial history before its destruction, the individual was among those who wore their uniforms while serving as Honor Guard sentries for the Yavin 4 ceremony.<ref name="Honor Guard" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Honor Guard first appeared during the ending scene of [[1977]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], during the ceremony honoring the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]]. Though uncredited in the film itself,<ref name="ANH" /> [[Wikipedia:English people|English]] actor [[Derek Lyons]] recalled portraying the character.<ref name="Lyons">{{WebCite|url=http://www.dereklyonssite.com/voren-naal-aka-the-medal-bearer.html|text=VOREN NA'AL AKA THE MEDAL BEARER|author=Derek Lyons|work=[http://www.dereklyonssite.com DEREK LYONS OFFICIAL SITE]|archivedate=20171110015221}}</ref>

===Non-canon content===
At the end of the ''A New Hope'' segment of the [[2006]] [[Infinities|non-canon]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy]]'' as well as the subsequent game ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]'', a cutscene plays that serves as a re-imagining of the award ceremony. Although the cutscene includes sentries standing at the entrance to the ceremony, their uniforms are those of [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]] belonging to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]], as opposed to the [[canon]]ical Honor Guard uniforms.<ref name="Lego OT">''[[LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy]]''</ref><ref name="Lego Complete">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]''</ref>
